```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "C.UTF-8"))
library(data.table)
library(DT)
# R code here is ASCII only (HTML entities for special characters), so the page renders the same in any locale
A <- "docs/assets/fdr_panel10nc_q010"
ov <- fread(file.path(A, "fdr_overview.tsv")); rounds <- fread(file.path(A, "adaptive_rounds.tsv"))
g <- fread(file.path(A, "significant_genes.tsv")); cons <- fread(file.path(A, "consistency.tsv")); fu <- fread(file.path(A, "follow_up.tsv"))
fmt <- function(n) format(n, big.mark=",", trim=TRUE, scientific=FALSE)
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x)
counts <- function(a, b) sprintf("%s (%s)", fmt(a), fmt(b))
any_tp <- ov[tp == "any timepoint"]
effect_reads <- function(d, t) fifelse(is.na(d[[paste0("dpsi_", t)]]), "no score",
  sprintf("%+.0f (%s)", 100 * d[[paste0("dpsi_", t)]], fmt(d[[paste0("het_cov_", t)]])))
best_q <- function(d) signif(pmin(d$q_bh_0hr, d$q_bh_1hr, d$q_bh_6hr, na.rm=TRUE), 2)
pattern_labels <- c("all three timepoints"="Reported at 3 timepoints", "two timepoints"="Reported at 2 timepoints",
                    "shared, below threshold elsewhere"="One timepoint; nominal support elsewhere",
                    "candidate timepoint-specific"="One timepoint; no nominal support elsewhere",
                    "not testable elsewhere"="One timepoint; no usable score elsewhere")
g[, display_pattern := unname(pattern_labels[pattern])]
blank <- function(x) fifelse(is.na(x) | !nzchar(as.character(x)), "", as.character(x))
annot <- function(d) d[, .(`Neuronal GO term`=blank(neuronal_go),
  `Developmental disorder or autism`=fifelse(nzchar(blank(sfari)) & nzchar(blank(ddg2p)), paste0(blank(sfari), "; ", blank(ddg2p)), paste0(blank(sfari), blank(ddg2p))),
  `Expression after stimulation`=blank(expression_response), `Splicing after stimulation`=fifelse(stim_splicing %in% TRUE, "yes", ""))]
interactive_table <- function(d) DT::datatable(as.data.frame(d), rownames=FALSE, filter="top", extensions="Buttons",
  options=list(pageLength=10, lengthMenu=c(10, 25, 50), scrollX=TRUE, order=list(), dom="Blfrtip", buttons=c("copy", "csv")),
  caption="Search or filter genes, sort columns, and export the filtered table as CSV.")
new_genes <- g[previous == FALSE, gene]
fug <- merge(fu, g, by=c("gene", "sig_tps", "previous"))
relevance <- function(d) { r <- character(nrow(d))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) { x <- c(if (nzchar(blank(d$neuronal_go[i]))) paste0(d$neuronal_go[i], " (GO)"), blank(d$sfari[i]), blank(d$ddg2p[i]),
    if (nzchar(blank(d$expression_response[i]))) paste("expression:", d$expression_response[i]), if (d$stim_splicing[i] %in% TRUE) "splicing after stimulation")
    r[i] <- paste(x[nzchar(x)], collapse="; ") }; r }
fig_genes <- sort(fu[has_figures == TRUE, gene])
# which change brings a new gene in (10.page_tables_q010.R, new_because)
why_lab <- c(q="lower q", dpsi="lower &#124;&Delta;PSI&#124;", both="both", either="either")
why_long <- c(q="the lower q cutoff alone", dpsi="the lower &#124;&Delta;PSI&#124; cutoff alone", both="both changes together", either="either change alone")
nw <- g[previous == FALSE, .(genes=paste(sort(gene), collapse=", ")), by=new_because][match(names(why_long), new_because)][!is.na(new_because)]
new_text <- paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", why_long[nw$new_because], nw$genes), collapse="; ")
```

This page reports **transcript-based isoLASER** without the clustering filter at the
cutoffs chosen on 2026-10-28: **BH q < 0.10** and **\|ΔPSI\| ≥ 0.05**, with
isoLASER's `cis` label. The [earlier page](isolaser_fdr_panel10nc.html) used q < 0.05
and \|ΔPSI\| ≥ 0.10. Everything else is unchanged and described there: the run,
the donors and family rules, the permutation test and BH within each timepoint.
The q-values themselves are the same. BH was computed over the full family of
tested associations in each timepoint, before the `cis` / ΔPSI screen, so the new
cutoffs only report more of them. The FDR target is now 10% within each
timepoint's full family. The effect-filtered subset and the union across
timepoints have no separate guarantee.

**Main result:** `r fmt(any_tp$reported_associations)` associations in
**`r fmt(any_tp$reported_genes)` genes** pass, against
`r fmt(any_tp$previous_associations)` in `r fmt(any_tp$previous_genes)` genes at
the earlier cutoffs. None are lost. The `r length(new_genes)` new genes enter through
`r new_text`.

# Genome-wide results

```{r overview}
knitr::kable(ov[, .(Timepoint=tp, `Tested associations`=fmt(tested),
  `Paper's cutoff`=counts(paper_associations, paper_genes),
  `Screen (&#124;&Delta;PSI&#124; &ge; 0.05)`=counts(screen_associations, screen_genes),
  `Reported: screen + q < 0.10`=counts(reported_associations, reported_genes),
  `Earlier cutoffs (q < 0.05, &#124;&Delta;PSI&#124; &ge; 0.10)`=counts(previous_associations, previous_genes))], align="lrrrrr", escape=FALSE)
```

Cells other than **Tested associations** show **associations (genes)**.

- **Paper's cutoff:** isoLASER's own `cis` call with no other filter, as in the
  isoLASER paper.
- **Screen** (our definition), before FDR control: isoLASER's `cis` rule on the
  panel-heterozygous donors, plus \|ΔPSI\| ≥ 0.05.
- **Reported:** the screen plus q < 0.10.
- **Earlier cutoffs:** what the earlier page reported.

**Any timepoint** counts each gene or association once across timepoints.

# How the test works

The test is the one described on the [original page](isolaser_fdr.html#how-the-test-works),
with this run's donor and family rules ([earlier page](isolaser_fdr_panel10nc.html)).

```{r rounds}
knitr::kable(rounds[, .(Timepoint=tp, `Stopped at 1,000`=fmt(stopped_1e3),
  `Stopped at 10,000`=fmt(stopped_1e4), `Stopped at 100,000`=fmt(stopped_1e5),
  `Reached 1,000,000`=fmt(reached_1e6))], align="lrrrr")
```

**Stopped** means at least 20 hits at that checkpoint, or no observed score
(p = 1).

![](assets/fdr_panel10nc_q010/qq.png)

Real data only; there are no calibration runs for this run.

# Genes to follow up

We apply the same two conditions as the earlier page (our definitions):

1. **Reported only after stimulation:** at 1 or 6 hours, not at 0 hours.
2. **Neuron- or stimulation-related:** a neuronal GO term, a disorder in SFARI
   or DDG2P, or a change in expression or splicing after stimulation in our data.

`r nrow(fu)` genes meet both, `r sum(!fu$previous)` of them new at these cutoffs.

```{r follow}
knitr::kable(fug[order(!has_figures, gene), .(Gene=gene, `Reported at`=sig_tps,
  `0 hr`=effect_reads(.SD, "0hr"), `1 hr`=effect_reads(.SD, "1hr"), `6 hr`=effect_reads(.SD, "6hr"),
  `Best q`=best_q(.SD), `New at these cutoffs`=fifelse(previous, "", unname(why_lab[new_because])), Relevance=relevance(.SD),
  Figures=fifelse(has_figures, "below", ""))], align="llrrrrlll", escape=FALSE)
```

**0 / 1 / 6 hr**: allelic effect in percentage points, alternative minus
reference inclusion, with pooled informative coverage in brackets, for the gene's
representative association. **Best q**: its lowest timepoint-specific q-value. **New at these cutoffs**: for
genes not reported at the earlier cutoffs, which change brings them in.
**Figures**: the genes with figures from the earlier page, shown below. The
descriptions of these genes are on the [earlier page](isolaser_fdr_panel10nc.html#genes-to-follow-up).
The other genes have no figures yet.

```{r fig_blocks, results="asis"}
for (gn in fig_genes) {
  cat("## ", gn, "\n\n", sep="")
  cat("**Permutation test**\n\n![](assets/fdr_panel10nc_q010/", gn, "_null.png)\n\n", sep="")
  cat("**Read alignments** ([PDF](assets/fdr_panel10nc_q010/", gn, "_sashimi.pdf))\n\n![](assets/fdr_panel10nc_q010/", gn, "_sashimi.png)\n\n", sep="")
  iso <- sort(list.files(A, pattern=paste0("^isoforms_", gn, "_[0-9]+hr[.]png$")))
  if (length(iso)) { cat("**Isoforms and haplotypes**\n\n", sep="")
    for (f in iso) cat("![](assets/fdr_panel10nc_q010/", f, ")\n\n", sep="") }
}
```

# All reported genes

Here, **reported** means q < 0.10, `cis` and \|ΔPSI\| ≥ 0.05.

```{r patterns}
pat <- g[, .N, by=pattern][match(names(pattern_labels), pattern)][!is.na(pattern)]
knitr::kable(pat[, .(Pattern=unname(pattern_labels[pattern]), Genes=N)], align="lr")
```

For genes reported at one timepoint, the last three categories describe the
representative association at the other timepoints: nominal p < 0.05 there,
p ≥ 0.05 where scored, or no usable score. They are not tests of an allele × time
interaction. Among comparisons of reported associations with another timepoint,
`r pct(cons$nominal_p_lt_0.05)` had nominal p < 0.05 there and
`r pct(cons$same_sign)` had the same effect direction.

## Full interactive gene table

All **`r nrow(g)` reported genes**. The variant, part, timepoint effects, best q
and donor count refer to the representative association, the one with the lowest
q. **Reported at** describes the gene across all its associations. **At earlier
cutoffs** marks genes also reported at q < 0.05 and \|ΔPSI\| ≥ 0.10.

```{r all}
interactive_table(cbind(g[, .(Gene=gene, Pattern=display_pattern, `Reported at`=sig_tps,
  `0 hr`=effect_reads(g, "0hr"), `1 hr`=effect_reads(g, "1hr"), `6 hr`=effect_reads(g, "6hr"),
  `Best q`=best_q(g), `Het donors`=max_het, `At earlier cutoffs`=fifelse(previous, "yes", "no"))], annot(g),
  g[, .(Variant=variant_qual, `Exonic part`=exonic_part)]))
```

**Data:** `11.fdr_results/10.page_tables_q010.R` writes this page's tables to
`docs/assets/fdr_panel10nc_q010/`, from `10.isolaser_permutation/out/adaptive_panel10nc/results/`.
The QQ plot, the adaptive rounds, the paper's-cutoff counts and the figures are
copied unchanged from the earlier page, because they don't depend on the cutoffs.
